222 int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_findDCEstStaticParams(uint32_t numSamples, uint32_t *scaleVal, uint32_t *shiftVal)
223 {
224 
225  uint32_t scale_best = 0U;
226  uint32_t shift_best = 6U;
227  uint32_t shift, scale_curr;
228 
229  for(shift = 0U; shift <= 14U; shift++)
230  {
231  scale_curr = ((uint32_t)1U << (shift + 8U + 6U)) / numSamples;
232  if((scale_curr > scale_best) && (scale_curr < (((uint32_t)1U << 9U) - 1U)))
233  {
234  scale_best = scale_curr;
235  shift_best = shift;
236  }
237  }
238 
239  *scaleVal = scale_best;
240  *shiftVal = shift_best;
241  return 0U;
242 
243 }
244

261 int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_findIntfStatsStaticParams(uint32_t numSamples, uint32_t SNRdB, uint32_t *scaleVal, uint32_t *shiftVal)
262 {
263 
264  uint32_t scale_best = 0;
265  uint32_t shift_best = 6;
266  uint32_t shift, scale_curr;
267  float scale_curr_float;
268  uint32_t temp;
269 
270  for(shift = 0U; shift <= 6U; shift++)
271  {
272  temp = 256U * 2U * ((uint32_t)1U << shift);
273  scale_curr_float = MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float)pow(10.0, ((double)SNRdB/20.0))/(float)numSamples)*(float)temp);
274  scale_curr = (uint32_t) (scale_curr_float);
275  if((scale_curr > scale_best) && (scale_curr < (((uint32_t)1U << 8U) - 1U)))
276  {
277  scale_best = scale_curr;
278  shift_best = shift;
279  }
280  }
281 
282  *scaleVal = scale_best;
283  *shiftVal = shift_best;
284 
285  return 0;
286 
287 }

310 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMATransposeCompressed
311 (
312  rangeProc_dpParams *dpParams,
313  rangeProcHWACompressionCfg *compressionParams,
314  EDMA_Handle handle,
315  DPEDMA_ChanCfg *chanCfg,
316  DPEDMA_ChainingCfg *chainingCfg,
317  uint32_t srcAddress,
318  uint32_t destAddress,
319  bool isTransferCompletionEnabled,
320  Edma_EventCallback transferCompletionCallbackFxn,
321  void* transferCompletionCallbackFxnArg,
322  Edma_IntrObject *intrObj
323 )
324 {
325  DPEDMA_syncABCfg syncABCfg;
326  int32_t retVal;
327 
328  /* dpedma configuration */
329  if(compressionParams->compressionMethod==HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_BFP)
330  {
331  syncABCfg.aCount = compressionParams->outputBytesPerBlock * compressionParams->rxAntPerBlock;
332  syncABCfg.bCount = compressionParams->numBlocks / compressionParams->rxAntPerBlock;
333  syncABCfg.cCount = dpParams->numChirpsPerFrame/2U;
334  syncABCfg.srcBIdx = (int32_t) compressionParams->outputBytesPerBlock * (int32_t) compressionParams->rxAntPerBlock;
335  syncABCfg.srcCIdx = (int16_t) 0U;
336  syncABCfg.dstBIdx = (int32_t) compressionParams->outputBytesPerBlock * (int32_t) compressionParams->rxAntPerBlock * (int32_t) dpParams->numChirpsPerFrame;
337  syncABCfg.dstCIdx = (int16_t) compressionParams->outputBytesPerBlock * (int8_t) compressionParams->rxAntPerBlock * 2;
338  }
339  else
340  {
341  syncABCfg.aCount = compressionParams->outputBytesPerBlock;
342  syncABCfg.bCount = compressionParams->numBlocks;
343  syncABCfg.cCount = dpParams->numChirpsPerFrame/2U;
344  syncABCfg.srcBIdx = (int32_t) compressionParams->outputBytesPerBlock;
345  syncABCfg.srcCIdx = (int16_t) 0U;
346  syncABCfg.dstBIdx = (int32_t) compressionParams->outputBytesPerBlock * (int32_t) dpParams->numChirpsPerFrame;
347  syncABCfg.dstCIdx = (int16_t) compressionParams->outputBytesPerBlock * 2;
348  }
349 
350  syncABCfg.srcAddress = srcAddress;
351  syncABCfg.destAddress= destAddress;
352 
353  retVal = DPEDMA_configSyncAB(handle,
354  chanCfg,
355  chainingCfg,
356  &syncABCfg,
357  true, /* isEventTriggered */
358  false, /* isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled */
359  isTransferCompletionEnabled, /* isTransferCompletionEnabled */
360  transferCompletionCallbackFxn,
361  transferCompletionCallbackFxnArg,
362  intrObj);
363 
364  if (retVal != SystemP_SUCCESS)
365  {
366  goto exit;
367  }
368 
369 exit:
370  return (retVal);
371 }

387 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWACommon
388 (
389  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj
390 )
391 {
392 
393  int32_t retVal;
394  rangeProc_dpParams *DPParams;
395  DPU_RangeProcHWA_HwaConfig *hwaCfg;
396  uint8_t EGEKparam[8] = {3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15};
397 
398  if (rangeProcObj == NULL)
399  {
400  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
401  goto exit;
402  }
403 
404  DPParams = &rangeProcObj->params;
405  hwaCfg = &rangeProcObj->hwaCfg;
406 
407  /***********************/
408  /* HWA COMMON CONFIG */
409  /***********************/
410  /* Config Common Registers */
411  retVal = HWA_initConfig(rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle);
412  if (retVal != 0)
413  {
414  goto exit;
415  }
416 
417  retVal = HWA_configCmpLFSRSeed0(0x0000000B);
418  if (retVal != 0)
419  {
420  goto exit;
421  }
422 
423  if(rangeProcObj->compressionCfg.compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_EGE)
424  {
425  retVal = HWA_configEGECompressKParams(EGEKparam);
426  if (retVal != 0)
427  {
428  goto exit;
429  }
430  }
431 #if defined(DATAPATH_TEST) || defined(OBJ_DETECTION_DDMA_TEST)
432  retVal = HWA_configTwidDitherEnable(HWA_FEATURE_BIT_DISABLE); // Disable dither for datapath bit-exact test
433  if (retVal != 0)
434  {
435  goto exit;
436  }
437 #else
438  retVal = HWA_configTwidDitherEnable(HWA_FEATURE_BIT_ENABLE); // Enable Dither for FFT twiddle factor to attenuate quantization spurs.
439  if (retVal != 0)
440  {
441  goto exit;
442  }
443 #endif
444  retVal = HWA_configFFTLFSRSeed(0x0B); /*Some non-zero value*/
445  if (retVal != 0)
446  {
447  goto exit;
448  }
449  retVal = HWA_configStateMachine(DPParams->numChirpsPerFrame / 2U, rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx,
450  (uint16_t) rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx + rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.numParamSet - 1U);
451  if (retVal != 0)
452  {
453  goto exit;
454  }
455 
456  /* DC Est shift and scale */
457  retVal = HWA_configDCEstimationProfile1((uint16_t)rangeProcObj->dcEstShiftScaleCfg.scale, (uint8_t)rangeProcObj->dcEstShiftScaleCfg.shift);
458  if (retVal != 0)
459  {
460  goto exit;
461  }
462 
463  /* Interf config */
464  retVal = HWA_configInterfSumMagScaler((uint16_t)rangeProcObj->intfStatsMagShiftScaleCfg.scale, (int8_t)rangeProcObj->intfStatsMagShiftScaleCfg.shift);
465  if (retVal != 0)
466  {
467  goto exit;
468  }
469 
470  retVal = HWA_configInterfSumMagDiffScaler((uint16_t)rangeProcObj->intfStatsMagDiffShiftScaleCfg.scale, (int8_t)rangeProcObj->intfStatsMagDiffShiftScaleCfg.shift);
471  if (retVal != 0)
472  {
473  goto exit;
474  }
475 
476  retVal = HWA_configInterfMitigationWindowParams(hwaCfg->hwaInterfMitigWindow);
477  if (retVal != 0)
478  {
479  goto exit;
480  }
481 
482  retVal = HWA_configTwiddleIncrDeltaFrac(0);
483  if (retVal != 0)
484  {
485  goto exit;
486  }
487 
488  /**********************************************/
489  /* ENABLE NUMLOOPS DONE INTERRUPT FROM HWA */
490  /**********************************************/
491  retVal = HWA_enableDoneInterrupt(rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle,
492  0, //thread index
493  rangeProcHWADoneIsrCallback,
494  (void*)&rangeProcObj->hwaDoneSemaHandle);
495  if (retVal != 0)
496  {
497  goto exit;
498  }
499 
500 exit:
501  return(retVal);
502 }
520 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWA(
521  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
522  DPU_RangeProcHWA_HW_Resources *pHwConfig,
523  uint8_t destChanPing,
524  uint8_t destChanPong)
525 {
526  HWA_InterruptConfig paramISRConfig;
527  int32_t errCode = 0;
528  uint8_t pingHwParamsetIdx, pongHwParamsetIdx;
529  HWA_ParamConfig hwaParamCfg;
530  HWA_Handle hwaHandle;
531  rangeProcHWACompressionCfg *pDPCompParams;
532  rangeProc_dpParams *pDPParams;
533  uint16_t index = 0U, rxAntIdx = 0U;
534 
535  hwaHandle = rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle;
536  pDPParams = &rangeProcObj->params;
537  pDPCompParams = &rangeProcObj->compressionCfg;
538 
539  pingHwParamsetIdx = rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
540  pongHwParamsetIdx = pingHwParamsetIdx + (rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.numParamSet / 2U);
541  for (index = 0; index < rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.numParamSet; index++)
542  {
543  errCode = HWA_disableParamSetInterrupt(hwaHandle, (uint8_t)index + rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx,
544  HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_CPU_INTR1 | HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA);
545  if (errCode != 0)
546  {
547  goto exit;
548  }
549  }
550 
551  /***********************/
552  /* PING DUMMY PARAMSET */
553  /***********************/
554  {
555  (void)memset(&hwaParamCfg, 0, sizeof(hwaParamCfg));
556  if (rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE)
557  {
558  /* Once, the DC Est. and Interf. Stats. are programmed, trigger is given by software */
559  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_SOFTWARE;
560  }
561  else
562  {
563  /* No SW intervenetion, once ping chirp result is copied out, signature channel triggers the paramset. */
564  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
565  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = pingHwParamsetIdx;
566  }
567  hwaParamCfg.accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_NONE;
568 
569  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
570  pingHwParamsetIdx,
571  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
572  if (errCode != 0)
573  {
574  goto exit;
575  }
576 #ifdef DATAPATH_TEST
577  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_CPU_INTR1;
578  paramISRConfig.cpu.callbackFn = DPU_RangeProcHWA_Test_adcDataIn;
579  paramISRConfig.cpu.callbackArg = NULL;
580  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(hwaHandle, pingHwParamsetIdx, &paramISRConfig);
581  if (errCode != 0)
582  {
583  goto exit;
584  }
585 #endif
586  }
587 
588  /***********************/
589  /* PONG DUMMY PARAMSET */
590  /***********************/
591  {
592  if (rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE)
593  {
594  /* Once, the DC Est. and Interf. Stats. are programmed, trigger is given by software */
595  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_SOFTWARE;
596  }
597  else
598  {
599  /* No SW intervenetion, once ping chirp result is copied out, signature channel triggers the paramset. */
600  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
601  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = pongHwParamsetIdx;
602  }
603  hwaParamCfg.accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_NONE;
604  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
605  pongHwParamsetIdx,
606  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
607  if (errCode != 0)
608  {
609  goto exit;
610  }
611 #ifdef DATAPATH_TEST
612  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(hwaHandle, pongHwParamsetIdx, &paramISRConfig);
613  if (errCode != 0)
614  {
615  goto exit;
616  }
617 #endif
618  }
619 
620  if(rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_DEFAULT_MODE)
621  {
622  (void)memset(&hwaParamCfg, 0, sizeof(hwaParamCfg));
623  /**************************************************************/
624  /* DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_DEFAULT_MODE: PING DC ESTIMATION PARAMSET */
625  /**************************************************************/
626  {
627  pingHwParamsetIdx++;
628 
629  if (rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_HWA_INTERNAL_MEM)
630  {
631  /* At a HWA trigger time adc samples are already in HWA memory */
632  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_HARDWARE;
633  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.hardwareTrigSrc;
634  }
635  else
636  {
637  /* adcbuf not mapped, HWA is triggered after edma copy is done */
638  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
639  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = pingHwParamsetIdx;
640  }
641 
642  hwaParamCfg.accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_FFT;
643 
644  /* PREPROC CONFIG */
645  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.fftMode.preProcCfg.dcEstResetMode = HWA_DCEST_INTERFSUM_RESET_MODE_PARAMRESET;
646 
647  /* ACCELMODE CONFIG */
648  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.fftMode.fftEn = HWA_FEATURE_BIT_DISABLE; /* No FFT is being performed here */
649 
650  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.fftMode.postProcCfg.magLogEn = HWA_FFT_MODE_MAGNITUDE_LOG2_DISABLED;
651  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.fftMode.postProcCfg.fftOutMode = HWA_FFT_MODE_OUTPUT_DEFAULT;
652  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.fftMode.preProcCfg.complexMultiply.cmultMode = HWA_COMPLEX_MULTIPLY_MODE_DISABLE;
653 
654  /* SOURCE CONFIG */
655  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_DCEST_PING_IN;
656 
657  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = pDPParams->numAdcSamples - 1U; /* this is samples - 1 */
658  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->numRxAntennas * (int32_t)pDPParams->sizeOfInputSample;
659  if(rangeProcObj->isReal2XEnabled)
660  {
661  /* In Real2X Mode and size of sample is doubled as it is considered complex,
662  * number of Rx antennas is effectively halved, hence numRxAntennas needs to be even.*/
663  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcnt = ((uint16_t)(pDPParams->numRxAntennas) / 2U) - 1U;
664  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->sizeOfInputSample * 2;
665  }
666  else
667  {
668  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcnt = (uint16_t)pDPParams->numRxAntennas - 1U;
669  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->sizeOfInputSample;
670  }
671 
672  if (((bool)pDPParams->isReal) && (rangeProcObj->isReal2XEnabled == false))
673  {
674  hwaParamCfg.source.srcRealComplex = HWA_SAMPLES_FORMAT_REAL;

1121  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PING_IN;
1122 
1123  hwaParamCfg.source.srcRealComplex = HWA_SAMPLES_FORMAT_COMPLEX;
1124  hwaParamCfg.source.srcWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_16BIT;
1125  hwaParamCfg.source.srcSign = HWA_SAMPLES_SIGNED;
1126  hwaParamCfg.source.srcConjugate = HWA_FEATURE_BIT_DISABLE;
1127  hwaParamCfg.source.srcScale = 8;
1128 
1129  /* DEST CONFIG */
1130  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PING_OUT;
1131  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstRealComplex = HWA_SAMPLES_FORMAT_COMPLEX;
1132  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_16BIT; /* 16 bit real, 16 bit imag */
1133  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstSign = HWA_SAMPLES_UNSIGNED;
1134  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstConjugate = HWA_FEATURE_BIT_DISABLE;
1135  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstScale = 0;
1136  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstSkipInit = 0;
1137 
1138  if (pDPCompParams->compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_BFP)
1139  {
1140  /*************************************/
1141  /* PING BFP COMPRESSION PARAMSET RX1 */
1142  /*************************************/
1143  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.compressMode.BFPMantissaBW = (uint8_t) (((double)pDPCompParams->outputBytesPerBlock * 8.0) -
1144  (double)hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.compressMode.scaleFactorBW) /
1145  ((double)pDPCompParams->inputSamplesPerBlock * 2.0);
1146  /* SRC CONFIG */
1147  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = pDPCompParams->inputSamplesPerBlock - 1U;
1148  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t) pDPCompParams->bytesPerSample * (int32_t) pDPCompParams->rxAntPerBlock;
1149  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcnt = (pDPCompParams->numBlocks / pDPCompParams->rxAntPerBlock) - 1U;
1150  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t) pDPCompParams->inputBytesPerBlock * (int32_t) pDPCompParams->rxAntPerBlock;
1151 
1152  /* DEST CONFIG */
1153  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAcnt = pDPCompParams->outputSamplesPerBlock - 1U;
1154  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAIdx = (int32_t) pDPCompParams->bytesPerSample;
1155  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstBIdx = (int32_t) pDPCompParams->outputBytesPerBlock * (int32_t) pDPCompParams->rxAntPerBlock;
1156 
1157  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
1158  pingHwParamsetIdx,
1159  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
1160  if (errCode != 0)
1161  {
1162  goto exit;
1163  }
1164 
1165  /*****************************/
1166  /* PONG BFP COMPRESSION PARAMSET RX1 */
1167  /*****************************/
1168  pongHwParamsetIdx++;
1169  if (rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE)
1170  {
1171  /* once pong chirp result is copied out, signature channel triggers the paramset. */
1172  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
1173  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = pongHwParamsetIdx;
1174  }
1175  else
1176  {
1177  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_IMMEDIATE;
1178  }
1179  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PONG_IN;
1180  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PONG_OUT;
1181 
1182  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
1183  pongHwParamsetIdx,
1184  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
1185  if (errCode != 0)
1186  {
1187  goto exit;
1188  }
1189 
1190  for (rxAntIdx = 1; rxAntIdx < pDPCompParams->rxAntPerBlock; rxAntIdx++)
1191  {
1192  /*************************************/
1193  /* PING BFP COMPRESSION PARAMSET RXN */
1194  /*************************************/
1195  pingHwParamsetIdx++;
1196  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_IMMEDIATE;
1197  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = (uint32_t) DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PING_IN + ((uint32_t) rxAntIdx * (uint32_t) pDPCompParams->bytesPerSample);
1198  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = (uint32_t) DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PING_OUT + ((uint32_t) rxAntIdx * (uint32_t) pDPCompParams->outputBytesPerBlock);
1199  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
1200  pingHwParamsetIdx,
1201  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
1202  if (errCode != 0)
1203  {
1204  goto exit;
1205  }
1206 
1207  /*************************************/
1208  /* PONG BFP COMPRESSION PARAMSET RXN */
1209  /*************************************/
1210  pongHwParamsetIdx++;
1211  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_IMMEDIATE;
1212  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = (uint32_t) DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PONG_IN + ((uint32_t) rxAntIdx * (uint32_t) pDPCompParams->bytesPerSample);
1213  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = (uint32_t) DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PONG_OUT + ((uint32_t) rxAntIdx * (uint32_t) pDPCompParams->outputBytesPerBlock);
1214  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
1215  pongHwParamsetIdx,
1216  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
1217  if (errCode != 0)
1218  {
1219  goto exit;
1220  }
1221  }
1222  }
1223 
1224  else if (pDPCompParams->compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_EGE)
1225  {
1226  /*********************************/
1227  /* PING EGE COMPRESSION PARAMSET */
1228  /*********************************/
1229  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.compressMode.EGEKarrayLength = 3; // log2(8)
1230 
1231  /* SRC CONFIG */
1232  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = pDPCompParams->inputSamplesPerBlock - 1U;
1233  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t) pDPCompParams->bytesPerSample;
1234  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcnt = pDPCompParams->numBlocks - 1U;
1235  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t) pDPCompParams->inputBytesPerBlock;
1236 
1237  /* DEST CONFIG */
1238  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAcnt = pDPCompParams->outputSamplesPerBlock - 1U;
1239  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAIdx = (int32_t) pDPCompParams->bytesPerSample;
1240  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstBIdx = (int32_t) pDPCompParams->outputBytesPerBlock;
1241 
1242  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
1243  pingHwParamsetIdx,
1244  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
1245  if (errCode != 0)
1246  {
1247  goto exit;
1248  }
1249 
1250  /*********************************/
1251  /* PONG EGE COMPRESSION PARAMSET */
1252  /*********************************/
1253 
1254  pongHwParamsetIdx++;
1255  if (rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE)
1256  {
1257  /* once pong chirp result is copied out, signature channel triggers the paramset. */
1258  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
1259  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = pongHwParamsetIdx;
1260  }
1261  else
1262  {
1263  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_IMMEDIATE;
1264  }
1265  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PONG_IN;
1266  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_ADDR_COMP_PONG_OUT;
1267 
1268  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
1269  pongHwParamsetIdx,
1270  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
1271  if (errCode != 0)
1272  {
1273  goto exit;
1274  }
1275  }
1276  else
1277  {
1278  /* There is no other valid case */
1279  DebugP_assert(0);
1280  }
1281 
1282  /* enable the DMA hookup to this paramset so that data gets copied out */
1283  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA;
1284  paramISRConfig.dma.dstChannel = destChanPing;
1285  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(hwaHandle,
1286  pingHwParamsetIdx,
1287  &paramISRConfig);
1288  if (errCode != 0)
1289  {
1290  goto exit;
1291  }
1292 
1293  /* Enable the DMA hookup to this paramset so that data gets copied out */
1294  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA;
1295  paramISRConfig.dma.dstChannel = destChanPong;
1296  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(hwaHandle,
1297  pongHwParamsetIdx,
1298  &paramISRConfig);
1299  if (errCode != 0)
1300  {
1301  goto exit;
1302  }
1303  }
1304 exit:
1305  return (errCode);
1306 }

1323 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_TriggerHWA
1324 (
1325  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
1326  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config* rangeHwaCfg
1327 )
1328 {
1329  int32_t retVal = 0;
1330  HWA_Handle hwaHandle;
1331  uint8_t saveRestoreDataSize;
1332 
1333  /* Get HWA driver handle */
1334  hwaHandle = rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle;
1335 
1336  /* Disable the HWA */
1337  retVal = HWA_enable(hwaHandle, 0);
1338  if (retVal != 0)
1339  {
1340  goto exit;
1341  }
1342 
1343  /* Configure HWA common parameters */
1344  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWACommon(rangeProcObj);
1345  if(retVal < 0)
1346  {
1347  goto exit;
1348  }
1349 
1350  /* Enable the HWA */
1351  retVal = HWA_enable(hwaHandle, 1);
1352  if (retVal != 0)
1353  {
1354  goto exit;
1355  }
1356 
1357  if (rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE)
1358  {
1359  saveRestoreDataSize = rangeProcObj->params.numRxAntennas * 4U;
1360  DSSHWACCRegs *ctrlBaseAddr = (DSSHWACCRegs *)(((HWA_Object *)rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle)->hwAttrs->ctrlBaseAddr);
1361 
1362  /* Load First Chirp DC and Interference Estimates */
1363  rangeProcHWA_loadPreProcStats(rangeHwaCfg, (uint32_t)saveRestoreDataSize, (uint32_t)saveRestoreDataSize, 0U);
1364 
1365  /* SW trigger to HWA */
1366  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->FW2HWA_TRIG_0, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_END, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_START, 1U);
1367  }
1368 
1369  /* Trigger the HWA paramset for Ping */
1370  retVal = HWA_setDMA2ACCManualTrig(hwaHandle, rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[0]);
1371  if (retVal != 0)
1372  {
1373  goto exit;
1374  }
1375 
1376  /* Trigger the HWA paramset for Pong */
1377  retVal = HWA_setDMA2ACCManualTrig(hwaHandle, rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[1]);
1378  if (retVal != 0)
1379  {
1380  goto exit;
1381  }
1382 
1383 exit:
1384  return(retVal);
1385 }

1407 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMA_DataOut_interleave
1408 (
1409  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
1410  rangeProc_dpParams *DPParams,
1411  DPU_RangeProcHWA_HW_Resources *pHwConfig,
1412  uint32_t hwaInPingOffset,
1413  uint32_t hwaInPongOffset,

1415  uint32_t hwaOutPongOffset
1416 )
1417 {
1418  int32_t errorCode = SystemP_SUCCESS;
1419  EDMA_Handle handle ;
1420  DPEDMA_ChainingCfg chainingCfg;
1421  uint16_t pong_offset=1;
1422 
1423  /* Get rangeProc hardware resources pointer */
1424  handle = rangeProcObj->edmaHandle;
1425 
1426  /* Setup Chaining configuration */
1427  chainingCfg.chainingChannel = (uint8_t) pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.dataOutSignature.channel;
1428  chainingCfg.isIntermediateChainingEnabled = true;
1429  chainingCfg.isFinalChainingEnabled = true;
1430 
1431  if(rangeProcObj->compressionCfg.isEnabled)
1432  {
1433  errorCode = rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMATransposeCompressed(DPParams,
1434  &rangeProcObj->compressionCfg,
1435  handle,
1436  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPing,
1437  &chainingCfg,
1438  hwaInPingOffset,
1439  (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf,
1440  false, /* isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1441  NULL, /* transferCompletionCallbackFxn */
1442  NULL,
1443  pHwConfig->edmaTransferCompleteIntrObj);
1444  }
1445  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1446  {
1447  goto exit;
1448  }
1449  if(rangeProcObj->compressionCfg.isEnabled)
1450  {
1451 
1452  if(rangeProcObj->compressionCfg.compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_BFP)
1453  {
1454  pong_offset = rangeProcObj->compressionCfg.rxAntPerBlock;
1455  }
1456 
1457  errorCode = rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMATransposeCompressed(DPParams,
1458  &rangeProcObj->compressionCfg,
1459  handle,
1460  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPong,
1461  &chainingCfg,
1462  hwaInPongOffset,
1463  (uint32_t)(rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf + (rangeProcObj->compressionCfg.outputSamplesPerBlock * pong_offset)),
1464  true,
1465  rangeProcHWA_EDMA_transferCompletionCallbackFxn,
1466  (void *)rangeProcObj,
1467  pHwConfig->edmaTransferCompleteIntrObj);
1468  }
1469  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1470  {
1471  goto exit;
1472  }
1473 
1474  /**************************************************************************
1475  * HWA hot signature EDMA, chained to the transpose EDMA channels
1476  *************************************************************************/
1477  errorCode = DPEDMAHWA_configTwoHotSignature(handle,
1478  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.dataOutSignature,
1479  rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle,
1480  rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[0],
1481  rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[1],
1482  false);
1483  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1484  {
1485  goto exit;
1486  }
1487 
1488 exit:
1489  return(errorCode);
1490 }

1510 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMA_DataIn
1511 (
1512  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
1513  rangeProc_dpParams *DPParams,
1514  DPU_RangeProcHWA_HW_Resources *pHwConfig
1515 )
1516 {
1517  int32_t errorCode = SystemP_SUCCESS;
1518  EDMA_Handle handle ;
1519  uint16_t bytePerRxChan;
1520  DPEDMA_ChainingCfg chainingCfg;
1521 
1522  /* Get rangeProc Configuration */
1523  handle = rangeProcObj->edmaHandle;
1524 
1525  bytePerRxChan = DPParams->numAdcSamples * DPParams->sizeOfInputSample;
1526 
1527  /**********************************************/
1528  /* ADCBuf -> Ping/Pong Buffer(M0 and M1) */
1529  /**********************************************/
1530  chainingCfg.chainingChannel = (uint8_t)pHwConfig->edmaInCfg.dataInSignature.channel;
1531  chainingCfg.isFinalChainingEnabled = true;
1532  chainingCfg.isIntermediateChainingEnabled = true;
1533 
1534  if (rangeProcObj->interleave == DPIF_RXCHAN_NON_INTERLEAVE_MODE)
1535  {
1536  DPEDMA_syncABCfg syncABCfg;
1537 
1538  syncABCfg.srcAddress = (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->ADCdataBuf;
1539  syncABCfg.destAddress = rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_DCEST_PING_IN];
1540 
1541  syncABCfg.aCount = bytePerRxChan;
1542  syncABCfg.bCount = DPParams->numRxAntennas;
1543  syncABCfg.cCount = 2U; /* ping and pong */
1544 
1545  syncABCfg.srcBIdx = (int32_t) rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset;
1546  syncABCfg.dstBIdx = (int32_t) rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset;
1547  syncABCfg.srcCIdx = 0;
1548  syncABCfg.dstCIdx = (int16_t)((int32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_DCEST_PONG_IN] -
1549  (int32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_DCEST_PING_IN]);
1550 
1551  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncAB(handle,
1552  &pHwConfig->edmaInCfg.dataIn,
1553  &chainingCfg,
1554  &syncABCfg,
1555  true, /* isEventTriggered */
1556  /* Intermediate and Final transfer interrupts are enabled in case
1557  * the user wants to poll the IPR(H) register (for example,
1558  * in the range proc test case) or register an ISR for when a chirp
1559  * transfer from to HWA memory is complete */
1560  true, /* isIntermediateTransferInterruptEnabled */
1561  true, /*isFinalTransferInterruptEnabled */
1562  NULL,
1563  NULL,
1564  pHwConfig->edmaTransferCompleteIntrObj);
1565  }
1566  else
1567  {
1568  DPEDMA_syncACfg syncACfg;
1569 
1570  syncACfg.srcAddress = (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->ADCdataBuf;
1571  syncACfg.destAddress = rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_DCEST_PING_IN];
1572  syncACfg.aCount = bytePerRxChan * DPParams->numRxAntennas;
1573  syncACfg.bCount = 2U; /* ping and pong */
1574  syncACfg.dstBIdx = ((int32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_DCEST_PONG_IN] -
1575  (int32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_DCEST_PING_IN]);
1576  syncACfg.srcBIdx = 0;
1577 
1578  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncA_singleFrame(handle,
1579  &pHwConfig->edmaInCfg.dataIn,
1580  &chainingCfg,
1581  &syncACfg,
1582  /* Intermediate and Final transfer interrupts are enabled in case
1583  * the user wants to poll the IPR(H) register (for example,
1584  * in the range proc test case) or register an ISR for when a chirp
1585  * transfer from to HWA memory is complete */
1586  true, /* isEventTriggered */
1587  true, /* isIntermediateTransferInterruptEnabled */
1588  true, /* isFinalTransferInterruptEnabled */
1589  NULL,
1590  NULL,
1591  pHwConfig->edmaTransferCompleteIntrObj);
1592  }
1593 
1594  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1595  {
1596  goto exit;
1597  }
1598 
1599  /*************************************************/
1600  /* Generate Hot Signature to trigger Ping/Pong paramset */
1601  /*************************************************/
1602 
1603  errorCode = DPEDMAHWA_configTwoHotSignature(handle,
1604  &pHwConfig->edmaInCfg.dataInSignature,
1605  rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle,
1606  rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[0],
1607  rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[1],
1608  false);
1609 
1610  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1611  {
1612  goto exit;
1613  }
1614 exit:
1615  return(errorCode);
1616 }

1634 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigInterleaveMode
1635 (
1636  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
1637  rangeProc_dpParams *DPParams,
1638  DPU_RangeProcHWA_HW_Resources *pHwConfig
1639 )
1640 {
1641  int32_t retVal = 0;
1642  uint8_t destChanPing;
1643  uint8_t destChanPong;
1644  HWA_Handle hwaHandle;
1645 
1646  hwaHandle = rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle;
1647 
1648  /* In interleave mode, only edmaOutCfgFmt is supported */
1649  retVal = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(hwaHandle, (uint8_t)pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPing.channel, &destChanPing);
1650  if (retVal != 0)
1651  {
1652  goto exit;
1653  }
1654 
1655  /* In interleave mode, only edmaOutCfgFmt is supported */
1656  retVal = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(hwaHandle, (uint8_t)pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPong.channel, &destChanPong);
1657  if (retVal != 0)
1658  {
1659  goto exit;
1660  }
1661 
1662  if(pHwConfig->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_ISOLATED)
1663  {
1664  /* Copy data from ADC buffer to HWA buffer */
1665  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMA_DataIn(rangeProcObj, DPParams, pHwConfig);
1666 
1667  if(retVal < 0)
1668  {
1669  goto exit;
1670  }
1671  /* Range FFT configuration in HWA */
1672  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWA(rangeProcObj,
1673  pHwConfig,
1674  destChanPing,
1675  destChanPong
1676  );
1677  }
1678  else if (pHwConfig->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_MAPPED)
1679  {
1680  /* Range FFT configuration in HWA */
1681  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWA(rangeProcObj,
1682  pHwConfig,
1683  destChanPing,
1684  destChanPong
1685  );
1686  }
1687  else if (pHwConfig->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_HWA_INTERNAL_MEM)
1688  {
1689  /* Range FFT configuration in HWA */
1690  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWA(rangeProcObj,
1691  pHwConfig,
1692  destChanPing,
1693  destChanPong
1694  );
1695  }
1696  else
1697  {
1698  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
1699  }
1700  if(retVal < 0)
1701  {
1702  goto exit;
1703  }
1704 
1705  /* EDMA configuration */
1706  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMA_DataOut_interleave(rangeProcObj,
1707  DPParams,
1708  pHwConfig,
1709  (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_COMP_PING_OUT],
1710  (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_COMP_PONG_OUT],
1711  (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_FFT_PING_OUT],
1712  (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_FFT_PONG_OUT]);
1713 exit:
1714  return (retVal);
1715 }

1732 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ParseConfig
1733 (
1734  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
1735  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config *pConfigIn
1736 )
1737 {
1738  int32_t retVal = 0;
1739  rangeProc_dpParams *params;
1740  DPU_RangeProcHWA_StaticConfig *pStaticCfg;
1741  rangeProcHWACompressionCfg *compParams;
1742  float temp;
1743 
1744  /* Get configuration pointers */
1745  pStaticCfg = &pConfigIn->staticCfg;
1746  params = &rangeProcObj->params;
1747  compParams = &rangeProcObj->compressionCfg;
1748 
1749  /* Save datapath parameters */
1750  params->numTxAntennas = pStaticCfg->numTxAntennas;
1751  params->numRxAntennas = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas;
1752  params->numVirtualAntennas = pStaticCfg->numVirtualAntennas;
1753  params->numChirpsPerChirpEvent = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numChirpsPerChirpEvent;
1754  params->numAdcSamples = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples;
1755  params->numRangeBins = pStaticCfg->numRangeBins;
1756  params->numFFTBins = pStaticCfg->numFFTBins;
1757 
1758  if((bool)pStaticCfg->isChirpDataReal)
1759  {
1760  params->isReal = 1;
1761  params->sizeOfInputSample = (uint16_t) sizeof(int16_t);
1762  }
1763  else
1764  {
1765  params->isReal = 0;
1766  params->sizeOfInputSample = (uint16_t) sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t);
1767  }
1768  params->numChirpsPerFrame = pStaticCfg->numChirpsPerFrame;
1769  params->numDopplerChirps = pStaticCfg->numChirpsPerFrame/pStaticCfg->numTxAntennas;
1770  params->fftOutputDivShift = pStaticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.fftOutputDivShift;
1771  params->numLastButterflyStagesToScale = pStaticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.numLastButterflyStagesToScale;
1772 
1773  /* Save buffers */
1774  rangeProcObj->ADCdataBuf = (cmplx16ImRe_t *)pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.data;
1775 
1776  rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf = (cmplx16ImRe_t *)pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.data;
1777 
1778  /* Save interleave mode from ADCBuf configuraiton */
1779  rangeProcObj->interleave = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.interleave;
1780 
1781  if((rangeProcObj->interleave == DPIF_RXCHAN_NON_INTERLEAVE_MODE) &&
1782  (rangeProcObj->params.numRxAntennas > 1U))
1783  {
1784  /* For rangeProcDPU needs rx channel has same offset from one channel to the next channel
1785  Use first two channel offset to calculate the BIdx for EDMA
1786  */
1787  rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.rxChanOffset[1] -
1788  pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.rxChanOffset[0];
1789 
1790  /* rxChanOffset should be 16 bytes aligned and should be big enough to hold numAdcSamples */
1791  if ((rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset < (rangeProcObj->params.numAdcSamples * rangeProcObj->params.sizeOfInputSample)) ||
1792  ((rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset & 0xFU) != 0U))
1793  {
1794  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EADCBUF_INTF;
1795  goto exit;
1796  }
1797  }
1798 
1799  /* Save RadarCube format */
1800  if (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt == DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_2)
1801  {
1802  rangeProcObj->radarCubeLayout = rangeProc_dataLayout_RANGE_DOPPLER_TxAnt_RxAnt;
1803  }
1804  else if(pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt == DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_1)
1805  {
1806  rangeProcObj->radarCubeLayout = rangeProc_dataLayout_TxAnt_DOPPLER_RxAnt_RANGE;
1807  }
1808  else
1809  {
1810  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINTERNAL;
1811  goto exit;
1812  }
1813 
1814  /* Save compression parameters */
1815  compParams->isEnabled = pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.isEnabled;
1816  compParams->compressionMethod = pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.compressionMethod;
1817  if(compParams->compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_BFP)
1818  {
1819  compParams->inputSamplesPerBlock = pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock;
1820  }
1821  else
1822  {
1823  compParams->inputSamplesPerBlock = (pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock)
1824  * (pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.numRxAntennaPerBlock);
1825  }
1826  compParams->bytesPerSample = 4; /* Complex FFT */
1827 
1828  compParams->inputBytesPerBlock = compParams->bytesPerSample * compParams->inputSamplesPerBlock;
1829  compParams->numBlocks = (pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas * pStaticCfg->numRangeBins) /
1830  compParams->inputSamplesPerBlock;
1831  temp = ((float)compParams->inputBytesPerBlock * pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.compressionRatio + 3.99F) / 4.0F;
1832  compParams->outputBytesPerBlock = (uint16_t)temp * 4U; /* Word aligned */
1833 
1834  compParams->achievedCompressionRatio = (float) compParams->outputBytesPerBlock / (float) compParams->inputBytesPerBlock;
1835  compParams->outputSamplesPerBlock = compParams->outputBytesPerBlock/compParams->bytesPerSample;
1836  compParams->rangeBinsPerBlock = pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock;
1837  compParams->rxAntPerBlock = pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.numRxAntennaPerBlock;
1838 
1839  rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain = pStaticCfg->rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain;
1840  rangeProcObj->isReal2XEnabled = (bool)pStaticCfg->rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled;
1841  rangeProcObj->fftOutputScaling = pStaticCfg->rangeProcCfg.fftOutputScaling;
1842  if((pStaticCfg->isChirpDataReal == 0U) && (pStaticCfg->rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled == 1U))
1843  {
1844  /* Real2X mode with Complex ADC Data is invalid */
1845  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINTERNAL;
1846  goto exit;
1847  }
1848 
1849  /* Prepare internal hardware resouces = trigger source matchs its paramset index */
1850  rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[0] = 1U + pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
1851  rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[1] = (pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.numParamSet / 2U) + rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[0];
1852  if(rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE)
1853  {
1854  /* Signature channel triggers the compression paramset after the EDMA out is done. */
1855  rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[0] = 2U + pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
1856  rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[1] = (pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.numParamSet / 2U) + rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[0];
1857  }
1858  else
1859  {
1860  /* Signature channel triggers the dummy paramset after the EDMA out is done. */
1861  rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[0] = 0U + pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
1862  rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[1] = (pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.numParamSet / 2U) + rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[0];
1863  }
1864 
1865  /* Save hardware resources that will be used at runtime */
1866  rangeProcObj->edmaHandle= pConfigIn->hwRes.edmaHandle;
1867  rangeProcObj->dataOutSignatureChan = pConfigIn->hwRes.edmaOutCfg.dataOutSignature.channel;
1868  rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMean = pConfigIn->hwRes.dcRangeSigMean;
1869  rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMeanSize = pConfigIn->hwRes.dcRangeSigMeanSize;
1870  (void)memcpy((void *)&rangeProcObj->hwaCfg, (void *)&pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg, sizeof(DPU_RangeProcHWA_HwaConfig));
1871 
1872  /* DC Est shift and scale */
1873  rangeProcObj->dcEstShiftScaleCfg = pStaticCfg->dcEstShiftScaleCfg;
1874 
1875  /* Interf config */
1876  rangeProcObj->intfStatsMagShiftScaleCfg = pStaticCfg->intfStatsMagShiftScaleCfg;
1877  rangeProcObj->intfStatsMagDiffShiftScaleCfg = pStaticCfg->intfStatsMagDiffShiftScaleCfg;
1878 
1879 exit:
1880  return (retVal);
1881 }

1898 void rangeProcHWA_loadPreProcStats
1899 (
1900  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config* rangeHwaCfg,
1901  uint32_t saveRestoreDcEstDataSize,
1902  uint32_t saveRestoreIntfStatDataSize,
1903  uint8_t index
1904 )
1905 {
1906  uint8_t chanIdx = 0;
1907  uint32_t intfStatOffset = (index * saveRestoreIntfStatDataSize) / 4U;
1908  DSSHWACCRegs *ctrlBaseAddr = (DSSHWACCRegs *)(((HWA_Object *)RangeObj.initParms.hwaHandle)->hwAttrs->ctrlBaseAddr);
1909 
1910  if(saveRestoreDcEstDataSize > 0U)
1911  {
1912  /* Program the DC Estimation Values */
1913  (void)memcpy((void*)&ctrlBaseAddr->DC_I_SW[0], (void*)(rangeHwaCfg->hwRes.dcEstIVal + ((index * saveRestoreDcEstDataSize) / 4U)), saveRestoreDcEstDataSize);
1914 
1915  if((bool)rangeHwaCfg->staticCfg.rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled)
1916  {
1917  (void)memcpy((void*)&ctrlBaseAddr->DC_Q_SW[0], (void*)(rangeHwaCfg->hwRes.dcEstQVal + ((index * saveRestoreDcEstDataSize) / 4U)), saveRestoreDcEstDataSize);
1918  }
1919  }
1920 
1921  if(saveRestoreIntfStatDataSize > 0U)
1922  {
1923  for(chanIdx = 0; chanIdx < rangeHwaCfg->staticCfg.ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas; chanIdx++)
1924  {
1925  if(*(rangeHwaCfg->hwRes.intfThresMagDiffVal + intfStatOffset + chanIdx) < rangeHwaCfg->staticCfg.rangeProcCfg.intfMitigMagDiffThresMinLim)
1926  {
1927  *(rangeHwaCfg->hwRes.intfThresMagDiffVal + intfStatOffset + chanIdx) = rangeHwaCfg->staticCfg.rangeProcCfg.intfMitigMagDiffThresMinLim;
1928  }
1929  }
1930 
1931  /* Program the Interf Stats MagDiff Values. Programming Mag Thresold is not required beacuse we perform only magdiff threshold based interf localization.*/
1932  (void)memcpy((void*)&ctrlBaseAddr->INTF_LOC_THRESH_MAGDIFF_SW[0], (void*)(rangeHwaCfg->hwRes.intfThresMagDiffVal + intfStatOffset), saveRestoreIntfStatDataSize);
1933  }
1934 }

1952 void rangeProcHWA_storePreProcStats
1953 (
1954  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config* rangeHwaCfg,
1955  uint32_t saveRestoreDcEstDataSize,
1956  uint32_t saveRestoreIntfStatDataSize,
1957  uint8_t index
1958 )
1959 {
1960  DSSHWACCRegs *ctrlBaseAddr = (DSSHWACCRegs *)(((HWA_Object *)RangeObj.initParms.hwaHandle)->hwAttrs->ctrlBaseAddr);
1961 
1962  if(saveRestoreDcEstDataSize > 0U)
1963  {
1964  /* Read and store the DC Estimation values */
1965  (void)memcpy((void*)(rangeHwaCfg->hwRes.dcEstIVal + ((index * saveRestoreDcEstDataSize) / 4U)), (void*)&ctrlBaseAddr->DC_EST_I_VAL[0], saveRestoreDcEstDataSize);
1966 
1967  if((bool)rangeHwaCfg->staticCfg.rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled)
1968  {
1969  (void)memcpy((void*)(rangeHwaCfg->hwRes.dcEstQVal + ((index * saveRestoreDcEstDataSize) / 4U)), (void*)&ctrlBaseAddr->DC_EST_Q_VAL[0], saveRestoreDcEstDataSize);
1970  }
1971  }
1972 
1973  if(saveRestoreIntfStatDataSize > 0U)
1974  {
1975  /* Read and store the Interf Stats MagDiff Values. Storing Mag Thresold is not required beacuse we perform magdiff threshold based interf localization.*/
1976  (void)memcpy((void*)(rangeHwaCfg->hwRes.intfThresMagDiffVal + ((index * saveRestoreIntfStatDataSize) / 4U)), (void*)&ctrlBaseAddr->INTF_LOC_THRESH_MAGDIFF_VAL[0], saveRestoreIntfStatDataSize);
1977  }

2002 DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle DPU_RangeProcHWA_init
2003 (
2004  DPU_RangeProcHWA_InitParams *initParams,
2005  volatile uint8_t subframeCounter,
2006  int32_t* errCode
2007 )
2008 {
2009  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj = NULL;
2010  HWA_MemInfo hwaMemInfo;
2011  uint16_t index;
2012  int32_t status = SystemP_SUCCESS;
2013  uint32_t dcSubInitValues[12] = {0};
2014 
2015  *errCode = 0;
2016 
2017  if( (initParams == NULL) ||
2018  (initParams->hwaHandle == NULL) )
2019  {
2020  *errCode = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2021  goto exit;
2022  }
2023 
2024  DebugP_assert(subframeCounter < RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES);
2025 
2026  rangeProcObj = (rangeProcHWAObj*)&RangeObj;
2027 
2028  /* Initialize memory */
2029  (void)memset((void *)rangeProcObj, 0, sizeof(rangeProcHWAObj));
2030 
2031  (void)memcpy((void *)&rangeProcObj->initParms, (void *)initParams, sizeof(DPU_RangeProcHWA_InitParams));
2032 
2033  /* Set HWA bank memory address */
2034  *errCode = HWA_getHWAMemInfo(initParams->hwaHandle, &hwaMemInfo);
2035  if (*errCode < 0)
2036  {
2037  goto exit;
2038  }
2039 
2040  for (index = 0; index < hwaMemInfo.numBanks; index++)
2041  {
2042  rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[index] = hwaMemInfo.baseAddress + ((uint32_t)index * hwaMemInfo.bankSize);
2043  }
2044 
2045  /* Initialize HWA DC SW programmable registers values */
2046  *errCode = HWA_initConfig(initParams->hwaHandle);
2047  if (*errCode < 0)
2048  {
2049  goto exit;
2050  }
2051  *errCode = HWA_configDCSubtractionSWValues(dcSubInitValues, dcSubInitValues);
2052  if (*errCode < 0)
2053  {
2054  goto exit;
2055  }
2056 
2057  /* Create semaphore for EDMA done */
2058  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&rangeProcObj->edmaDoneSemaHandle, 0);
2059  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
2060  {
2061  *errCode = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ESEMA;
2062  goto exit;
2063  }
2064 
2065  /* Create semaphore for HWA done */
2066  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&rangeProcObj->hwaDoneSemaHandle, 0);
2067  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
2068  {
2069  *errCode = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ESEMA;
2070  goto exit;
2071  }
2072 
2073 exit:
2074  if(*errCode < 0)
2075  {
2076  rangeProcObj = (DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle)NULL;
2077  }
2078  else
2079  {
2080  /* Fall through */
2081  }
2082  return ((DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle)rangeProcObj);
2083 
2084 }

2105 int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_config
2106 (
2107  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle handle,
2108  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config *pConfigIn
2109 )
2110 {
2111  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj;
2112  DPU_RangeProcHWA_StaticConfig *pStaticCfg;
2113  HWA_Handle hwaHandle;
2114  int32_t retVal = 0;
2115 
2116  rangeProcObj = (rangeProcHWAObj *)handle;
2117  if(rangeProcObj == NULL)
2118  {
2119  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2120  goto exit;
2121  }
2122 
2123  /* Get configuration pointers */
2124  pStaticCfg = &pConfigIn->staticCfg;
2125  hwaHandle = rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle;
2126 
2127 #if DEBUG_CHECK_PARAMS
2128  /* Validate params */
2129  if(!pConfigIn ||
2130  !(pConfigIn->hwRes.edmaHandle) ||
2131  (pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.numParamSet != (DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_PARAM_SETS_DDMA +
2132  pStaticCfg->compressionCfg.bfpCompExtraParamSets -
2133  (2U * pStaticCfg->rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain)))
2134  )
2135  {
2136  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2137  goto exit;
2138  }
2139 
2140  /* Parameter check: validate Adc data interface configuration
2141  Support:
2142  - 1 chirp per chirpEvent
2143  - Complex 16bit ADC data in IMRE format supported for AM273X+2243 Processing Chain
2144  - Real only 16bit ADC data supported for AWR294X Processing Chain
2145  */
2146  if( (pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.dataFmt != DPIF_DATAFORMAT_REAL16) ||
2147  (pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numChirpsPerChirpEvent != 1U) )
2148  {
2149  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EADCBUF_INTF;
2150  goto exit;
2151  }
2152 
2153  /* Parameter check: windowing Size */
2154  {
2155  uint16_t expectedWinSize;
2156 
2157  if( pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.hwaWinSym == HWA_FFT_WINDOW_SYMMETRIC)
2158  {
2159  /* Only half of the windowing factor is needed for symmetric window */
2160  expectedWinSize = (uint16_t) ((pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples + 1U) / 2U ) * (uint16_t) sizeof(uint32_t);
2161  }
2162  else
2163  {
2164  expectedWinSize = (uint16_t) pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples * (uint16_t) sizeof(uint32_t);
2165  }
2166 
2167  if(pStaticCfg->windowSize != expectedWinSize)
2168  {
2169  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EWINDOW;
2170  goto exit;
2171  }
2172  }
2173 
2174  if(pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.data == NULL)
2175  {
2176  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ERADARCUBE_INTF;
2177  goto exit;
2178  }
2179 
2180 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
2181  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.data,
2182  DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_RADARCUBE_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_R5F))
2183 #else
2184  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.data,
2185  DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_RADARCUBE_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_DSP))
2186 #endif
2187  {
2188  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ERADARCUBE_INTF;
2189  goto exit;
2190  }
2191 
2192  /* Refer to radar cube definition for FORMAT_x , the following are the only supported formats
2193  Following assumption is made upon radar cube FORMAT_x definition
2194  1. data type is complex in cmplx16ImRe_t format only
2195  2. It is always Format 2 for DDMA (interleaved)
2196  */
2197  if( (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt != DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_2) )
2198  {
2199  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ERADARCUBE_INTF;
2200  goto exit;
2201  }
2202 
2203  /* Not supported input & output format combination */
2204  if ((pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.interleave == DPIF_RXCHAN_INTERLEAVE_MODE) &&
2205  (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt == DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_1) )
2206  {
2207  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ENOTIMPL;
2208  goto exit;
2209  }
2210  if (pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas == 3U)
2211  {
2212  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ENOTIMPL;
2213  goto exit;
2214  }
2215 
2216  /* Parameter check: Num butterfly stages to scale */
2217  if (pStaticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.numLastButterflyStagesToScale > mathUtils_ceilLog2(pStaticCfg->numRangeBins))
2218  {
2219  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EBUTTERFLYSCALE;
2220  goto exit;
2221  }
2222 #endif
2223 
2224  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ParseConfig(rangeProcObj, pConfigIn);
2225  if (retVal < 0)
2226  {
2227  goto exit;
2228  }
2229 
2230  /* Parameter check: radarcube buffer Size */
2231  if (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.dataSize != (((((pStaticCfg->numRangeBins * sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t)) *
2232  pStaticCfg->numChirpsPerFrame) *
2233  pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas) /
2234  rangeProcObj->compressionCfg.inputBytesPerBlock) *
2235  rangeProcObj->compressionCfg.outputBytesPerBlock))
2236  {
2237  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ERADARCUBE_INTF;
2238  goto exit;
2239  }
2240 
2241  /* Disable the HWA */
2242  retVal = HWA_enable(hwaHandle, 0);
2243  if (retVal != 0)
2244  {
2245  goto exit;
2246  }
2247 
2248  /* Windowing configuraiton in HWA */
2249  retVal = HWA_configRam(hwaHandle,
2250  HWA_RAM_TYPE_WINDOW_RAM,
2251  (uint8_t *)pStaticCfg->window,
2252  pStaticCfg->windowSize, /* size in bytes */
2253  pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.hwaWinRamOffset * sizeof(uint32_t));
2254  if (retVal != 0)
2255  {
2256  goto exit;
2257  }
2258 
2259  /* Clear stats */
2260  rangeProcObj->numProcess = 0U;
2261 
2262  /* Initial configuration of rangeProc */
2263  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigInterleaveMode(rangeProcObj, &rangeProcObj->params, &pConfigIn->hwRes);
2264 
2265 exit:
2266  return retVal;
2267 }
2268 
2288 int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_process
2289 (
2290  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle handle,
2291  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config* rangeHwaCfg,
2292  DPU_RangeProcHWA_OutParams *outParams
2293 )
2294 {
2295  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj;
2296  int32_t retVal = 0;
2297  uint32_t index;
2298  uint8_t fftPingParam, fftPongParam;
2299  uint32_t chirpIdx = 0U;
2300  size_t saveRestoreDataSize;
2301  DSSHWACCRegs *ctrlBaseAddr = (DSSHWACCRegs *)(((HWA_Object *)RangeObj.initParms.hwaHandle)->hwAttrs->ctrlBaseAddr);
2302  uint32_t baseAddr, regionId;
2303 
2304  rangeProcObj = (rangeProcHWAObj *)handle;
2305  if ((rangeProcObj == NULL) ||
2306  (outParams == NULL))
2307  {
2308  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2309  goto exit;
2310  }
2311 
2312  /* Set inProgress state */
2313  rangeProcObj->inProgress = true;
2314  outParams->endOfChirp = false;
2315  saveRestoreDataSize = (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->params.numRxAntennas * 4U; //bytes
2316 
2317  /* Only in DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE,
2318  * software intervention in active frame is required. */
2319  if(rangeProcObj->rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE)
2320  {
2321  baseAddr = EDMA_getBaseAddr(rangeProcObj->edmaHandle);
2322  DebugP_assert(baseAddr != 0U);
2323 
2324  regionId = EDMA_getRegionId(rangeProcObj->edmaHandle);
2325  DebugP_assert(regionId < SOC_EDMA_NUM_REGIONS);
2326 
2327  fftPingParam = rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx + (uint8_t)1U;
2328  fftPongParam = fftPingParam + (rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.numParamSet / (uint8_t) 2U);
2329 
2330  for(chirpIdx = 0U; chirpIdx < rangeProcObj->params.numChirpsPerFrame; chirpIdx += 2U)
2331  {
2332  { /* PING */
2333  index = chirpIdx % rangeHwaCfg->staticCfg.numBandsTotal;
2334 
2335  if(chirpIdx != 0U)
2336  {
2337  /* Load Ping Chirp DC and Interference Estimates */
2338  rangeProcHWA_loadPreProcStats(rangeHwaCfg, saveRestoreDataSize, saveRestoreDataSize, (uint8_t)index);
2339 
2340  /* SW trigger to HWA for Ping Chirp */
2341  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->FW2HWA_TRIG_0, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_END, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_START, 1U);
2342  }
2343 
2344  /* Wait for FFT paramset done interrupt from HWA - Ping */
2345  while(CSL_FEXTR(ctrlBaseAddr->PARAM_DONE_SET_STATUS[0], (uint32_t)fftPingParam, (uint32_t)fftPingParam) != 1U)
2346  {
2347  /* Wait */
2348  };
2349  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->PARAM_DONE_CLR[0], (uint32_t)fftPingParam, (uint32_t)fftPingParam, 1U);
2350 
2351  /* Store Ping Chirp DC and Interference Estimates */
2352  rangeProcHWA_storePreProcStats(rangeHwaCfg, saveRestoreDataSize, saveRestoreDataSize, (uint8_t)index);
2353  }
2354 
2355 
2356  { /* PONG */
2357  index = (chirpIdx + 1U) % rangeHwaCfg->staticCfg.numBandsTotal;
2358 
2359  /* Load Pong Chirp DC and Interference Estimates */
2360  rangeProcHWA_loadPreProcStats(rangeHwaCfg, saveRestoreDataSize, saveRestoreDataSize, (uint8_t)index);
2361 
2362  /* SW trigger to HWA for Pong Chirp */
2363  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->FW2HWA_TRIG_0, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_END, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_START, 1U);
2364 
2365  /* Wait for FFT paramset done interrupt from HWA - Pong */
2366  while(CSL_FEXTR(ctrlBaseAddr->PARAM_DONE_SET_STATUS[0], (uint32_t)fftPongParam, (uint32_t)fftPongParam) != 1U)
2367  {
2368  /* Wait */
2369  };
2370  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->PARAM_DONE_CLR[0], (uint32_t)fftPongParam, (uint32_t)fftPongParam, 1U);
2371 
2372  /* Store Pong Chirp DC and Interference Estimates */
2373  rangeProcHWA_storePreProcStats(rangeHwaCfg, saveRestoreDataSize, saveRestoreDataSize, (uint8_t)index);
2374  }
2375  }
2376  }
2377 
2378  /**********************************************/
2379  /* WAIT FOR HWA NUMLOOPS INTERRUPT */
2380  /**********************************************/
2381  /* wait for the all paramSets done interrupt */
2382  (void)SemaphoreP_pend(&rangeProcObj->hwaDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
2383 
2384  /**********************************************/
2385  /* WAIT FOR EDMA INTERRUPT */
2386  /**********************************************/
2387  (void)SemaphoreP_pend(&rangeProcObj->edmaDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
2388 
2389  /* Range FFT is done, disable Done interrupt */
2390  (void)HWA_disableDoneInterrupt(rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle, 0);
2391 
2392  /* Disable the HWA */
2393  retVal = HWA_enable(rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle, 0);
2394  if (retVal != 0)
2395  {
2396  goto exit;
2397  }
2398  /* Update stats and output parameters */
2399  rangeProcObj->numProcess++;
2400 
2401  /* Following stats is not available for rangeProcHWA */
2402  outParams->stats.processingTime = 0;
2403  outParams->stats.waitTime = 0;
2404 
2405  outParams->endOfChirp = true;
2406 
2407  /* Clear inProgress state */
2408  rangeProcObj->inProgress = false;
2409 
2410 exit:
2411 
2412  return retVal;
2413 }
2414

2436 int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_control
2437 (
2438  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle handle,
2439  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config* rangeHwaCfg,
2440  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd cmd,
2441  void* arg,
2442  uint32_t argSize
2443 )
2444 {
2445  int32_t retVal = 0;
2446  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj;
2447 
2448  /* Get rangeProc data object */
2449  rangeProcObj = (rangeProcHWAObj *)handle;
2450 
2451  /* Sanity check */
2452  if (rangeProcObj == NULL)
2453  {
2454  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2455  goto exit;
2456  }
2457 
2458  /* Check if control() is called during processing time */
2459  if(rangeProcObj->inProgress == true)
2460  {
2461  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINPROGRESS;
2462  goto exit;
2463  }
2464 
2465  /* Control command handling */
2466  switch(cmd)
2467  {
2468  case DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd_triggerProc:
2469  /* Trigger rangeProc in HWA */
2470  retVal = rangeProcHWA_TriggerHWA(rangeProcObj, rangeHwaCfg);
2471  break;
2472 
2473  default:
2474  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ECMD;
2475  break;
2476  }
2477 exit:
2478  return (retVal);
2479 }

2500 )
2501 {

2514  SemaphoreP_destruct(&rangeProcObj->edmaDoneSemaHandle);
2515  SemaphoreP_destruct(&rangeProcObj->hwaDoneSemaHandle);
2516 exit:
2517 
2518  return (retVal);
2519 }
